summary: Wrote a 7-phase plan. Phases 1-2 (Stage A) are the self-contained, independently-committable four-site load_fidelity_map() doc_id-fallback fix in literature-search.sh plus Group A verification. Phases 3-5 (Stage B) add a --legacy-schema classification and write mode to literature-fidelity-audit.sh for the 6 source-recoverable Group B docs. Phases 6-7 are BLOCKED gates: the DJVU extractor prerequisite, and the user decision on the 10 unrecoverable docs.

blockers.description: Phase 6 gate: chagrovzakharyaschev_1997_modallogic cannot be classified -- no djvutxt/djvups installed and PyMuPDF 1.27.2 fails on the recovered .djvu. Needs user authorization to install djvulibre; an OCR workaround is explicitly NOT authorized. Gates phase 6 only; phases 1-5 proceed.

Phase 7 gate: disposition of the 10 unrecoverable docs is an explicit USER DECISION between option (b) per-doc adjudication to unverified_no_baseline, option (c) a new non-quarantined fidelity value, and option (d) leave as-is. The implementer MUST NOT choose. Gates phase 7 only; phases 1-5 proceed.

decisions_made: Patch load_fidelity_map() in place at all four sites; do NOT factor into a shared module (separate subprocess heredocs, no shared import path)
Stage A (phases 1-2) commits independently before Stage B starts, so the tractable half ships first
QUARANTINED_FIDELITY_VALUES is never modified; fail-open-to-unverified is preserved as-is
arisakadasstrassburger_2015 landing on a quarantined value is an honest outcome -- thresholds must not be loosened
File scope is literature-search.sh and literature-fidelity-audit.sh only; no Cslib/ Lean source
dead_ends: Pointing literature-fidelity-audit.sh at the legacy schema unmodified -- its sources/ root, chunk_*.md exclusion filter, and id-presence requirement in resolve_targets() each independently prevent a match
Zotero re-acquisition for the 10 unrecoverable docs -- zotero-library.json is a stale 400-record export containing none of the 18
PyMuPDF 1.27.2 as a djvu fallback -- fitz.open() raises FileDataError on the recovered .djvu
